Every module compiled here is I/O-free: `lib/assessment-blueprint.ts` imports only `session-concepts`, `ingest/hash` and `sha256`; `lib/assessment-generation.ts` adds `ai-guard` (pure) and `concept-resolution` (imports nothing); `lib/question-bank.ts` adds `taxonomy/build` (types only). That is what makes 'the manifest is frozen before any model call' provable with no Supabase project and no API key in reach (U.3, the determinism boundary).
